say:0:1432601001:1.text:
The flower Feli planted is slowly beginning to bloom.
It feels like only a breath ago that his hands pressed the seed into the soil... and yet, somehow, it feels like a lifetime has passed.
say:0:1432601001:1.source_cn: 斐利尔亲手种下的花，在缓缓生长。\n埋下种子的时刻仿佛...

say:1:1432601002:1.text: Feli, do you know? The mirage bloom you planted has brushed against the wind, tasted the morning dew... and now it dances in the sunlight, searching for the warmth of your smile.
say:1:1432601002:1.source_cn: 斐利尔，你知道吗？你种下的幻影花亲吻过轻风，啜饮过晨露...
